summary: John's 1st cousin 7x removed; early coal operator ruined by the trade.
bio: Daniel Davenport (1797-1840) 'became seriously involved in the coal trade' and lost most of his estate; Wright, who sat on the same school bench, says these troubles 'undoubtedly' caused his early death.
